title: I don't like my mallworld
content: I can't explain why I don't like.it. Some dreams that take place in the mallworld aren't nightmares or even bad dreams, some are just very vivid and nothing out of the ordinary happens. However, all the places in my mallworld are filled with foreboding. Nice pretty places as well: a gorgeous house, a swimming pool, a seaside shopping plaza. They terrify me. I'm sometimes afraid to sleep because I don't want to go there. Does anyone else have this feeling?
